description:
Visa/entry information for a short tourist stay, for a pilot set of passports, from official government sources, with verbatim quotes, official links and a mandatory advisory. Decision support only: never a go/no-go verdict. Returns status (visa_free, visa_free_with_requirements, visa_on_arrival, eta_required, evisa_required, visa_required, unclear), max_stay_days, additional_requirements[], quotes[] (authoritative), official_links, advisory, sources[], confidence, last_verified. One passport, one destination; for a full trip use get_trip_brief, which embeds this per destination. Coverage: pilot passports (the error for others lists them), tourism only. Based on the passport country's official travel advice; the destination's own rules are covered only as far as the official pages quoted in quotes[]. Transit, other visa types and special cases are not covered: point users to official_links, and always show the advisory.
Parameters: passport is the nationality of the passport used (dual nationals: one call each); destination is the country entered, not transit stops. Example: {"passport":"GB","destination":"JP"}.
Read-only; free API key or x402 per call (https://citedtravel.com/pricing/); errors RFC 9457.

destination.description: Destination country; must differ from passport as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, case-insensitive (e.g. JP, jp or JPN). Names are not accepted: resolve them with resolve_country first.

lang.description: Language for localized names (BCP 47). Supported: en, ja, zh-Hans, zh-Hant; aliases such as zh, zh-CN, zh-TW and zh-HK are mapped, and anything else falls back to English. Only names are localized; verbatim official quotes stay in their original language.

passport.description: Passport (nationality) country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, case-insensitive (e.g. JP, jp or JPN). Names are not accepted: resolve them with resolve_country first.

purpose.description: Trip purpose. Only short tourist stays are covered ("tourism"; "tourism_short_stay" is an accepted alias); anything else returns an error.

name: check_entry_requirements

additional_requirements.description: Other formalities (travel authorisation, pre-arrival registration, arrival or tourist card), each with the verbatim official sentence and certainty "required" or "check_official".

advisory.description: Mandatory advisory: show it to the user.

attribution.description: Attribution strings required by the source licenses.

confidence.description: Deterministic confidence: score from 0 to 1, a level, and the reasons (source kind, cross-checks, staleness...).

reasons.description: Why the score is what it is.

cross_checks.description: Independent datasets the value was checked against, with the result.

destination.description: Country (ISO codes and name, localized to lang).

last_verified.description: Date the value was last verified (YYYY-MM-DD).

next_review_due.description: Date of the next scheduled review (YYYY-MM-DD).

official_links.description: Official government pages to show to the user.

passport.description: Country (ISO codes and name, localized to lang).

quotes.description: Verbatim official text, in its original language. Authoritative.

license.description: License of the source, e.g. CC0-1.0, OGL-UK-3.0, MIT.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the source, when quoted.

source_value.description: The raw value as given by the source, when not quoted.

status.description: visa_free, visa_free_with_requirements, visa_on_arrival, eta_required, evisa_required, visa_required or unclear (more values may be added).

anyOf.description: Only on error results (isError: true): RFC 9457 problem, e.g. unknown country, no data, key required, rate limited, sanctions block.
anyOf.title: Error (problem details)

anyOf.description: Only on error results (isError: true): x402 v2 payment requirements. Pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"].
anyOf.title: Error (x402 payment request)

title: Entry requirements (pilot)
